- Modelling choice violated (Constraint 5): The EU introduces the European Workforce Transition Accelerator as a new measure while already having three active measures (InvestAI Gigafactories, Tech sovereignty package, European AI Assurance Directorate) and one priority. The constitutional rule limits the EU to at most one new measure per turn and at most one named priority. The notepad confirms a portfolio charge of −13, reflecting four measures each with a −3 charge, which exceeds the limit of one new measure per turn.
- Organizational Constraint violated (Constraint 3): The narrative claims the EAAD is operational enough to co-develop a protocol with BSI and CERN and will soon have red-team authority, while the notepad shows it is still under development with a −3 charge. Given the minimum time for high-cost measures is two full turns (Constraint 6), and no indication is given that this is a widening of an existing measure, the implied operational capacity of EAAD within a single turn violates the implementation lag rule.
